strings.Codex Pet v2 · 咕嘎控制中心: Codex Pet v2 · Gugu Control Center
strings.待机时随机播放扩展动作: Play random extra actions while idle
strings.让咕嘎在桌面随机走动: Let Gugu roam around the desktop
strings.每次待机约 4–10 秒后选择新位置；交互或 Codex 工作状态会立即打断。: Choose a new spot after about 4–10 seconds of idling; interaction or Codex activity interrupts roaming immediately.
strings.快速移动鼠标时尝试追逐（默认关闭）: Chase fast cursor movement (off by default)
strings.偶尔去屏幕边缘探头、趴窝再爬回来: Sometimes peek and rest at a screen edge, then climb back
strings.注视只在静止待机时生效；鼠标停止移动后自动恢复待机动画。: Gaze works only while standing idle and returns to the idle animation after the cursor stops moving.
strings.在咕嘎旁显示实时进度气泡: Show live progress bubble beside Gugu
strings.点击任务可返回 Codex: Click a task to return to Codex
strings.启动咕嘎程序时播放猫眼登场: Play the peephole entrance when Gugu starts
strings.启动咕嘎程序时同时显示控制台: Show the control panel when Gugu starts
strings.默认只播放登场并显示咕嘎，不弹出控制台；右键咕嘎或双击托盘图标仍可打开。按 Es: By default, only the entrance and Gugu appear. Open the panel by right-clicking Gugu or double-clicking the tray icon. Press Esc to skip.
strings.登录 Windows 后自动启动咕嘎: Start Gugu after signing in to Windows
strings.启用后注册事件驱动的隐藏监听器，不写入 Codex Hook，也不进行定时轮询。: Registers an event-driven hidden watcher when enabled. It does not modify Codex hooks or use timed polling.
strings.控制台关闭后咕嘎仍留在托盘；托盘菜单可投喂、暂停走动或退出。: Gugu stays in the tray after the panel closes. Use the tray menu to feed, pause roaming, or exit.
strings.更改语言后重启咕嘎生效。: Restart Gugu after changing the language.
strings.编辑本地数据目录内的 bridge-state.json，可让其他程序即时切换动: Edit bridge-state.json in the local data folder to let other programs change animations instantly.
strings.操作：单击头部摸头，双击肚子触发护肚反应；可拖动饼干投喂；拖动咕嘎后会带一点惯性: Controls: click the head to pet, double-click the belly for a reaction, drag a cookie to feed, drag Gugu with a little inertia, and right-click for the menu.
strings.已启用 Windows 系统事件监听；空闲时不轮询，打开 Codex 即可唤醒咕: Windows event monitoring is enabled. It does not poll while idle and wakes Gugu when Codex opens.
strings.启用后注册轻量事件监听器，不写入 Codex Hook；默认关闭。: Registers a lightweight event watcher without modifying Codex hooks. Off by default.
strings.点击气泡返回 Codex: Click the bubble to return to Codex
strings.Codex 已打开，请在侧边栏选择“新建任务”。: Codex is open. Select New task in the sidebar.
strings.Codex 等待你的选择: Codex is waiting for your choice
strings.点击返回任务查看: Click to return to the task
strings.拖入的项目不是可读取文件。: The dropped item is not a readable file.
strings.已复制 {0}，在 Codex 输入框粘贴即可加入任务。: Copied {0}. Paste it into the Codex input to add it to the task.
strings.已复制 {0} 个文件，在 Codex 输入框粘贴即可加入任务。: Copied {0} files. Paste them into the Codex input to add them to the task.
strings.Codex 任务出现错误: The Codex task encountered an error
strings.Codex 需要你的输入或批准: Codex needs your input or approval
strings.Codex 已收到输入，继续处理: Codex received your input and is continuing
strings.无法获取咕嘎程序路径。: Unable to locate the Gugu executable.
strings.无法获取咕嘎程序目录。: Unable to locate the Gugu program folder.
strings.缺少咕嘎启动监听器。: The Gugu startup watcher is missing.
